title: Investigate sending to Claude Code sessions devhost did not start
description:
Claude Code session files advertise `messagingSocketPath`, `peerProtocol` and `peerFeatures`. That suggests a local channel to other sessions, which would let devhost offer sending as well as warning. None of it has been tested, and it is undocumented.

Establish whether a supported interface exists, what it delivers and how it acknowledges. Test only against disposable sessions, never live ones. Close this without code if the interface is not supported.
